named_method: Data-grounded analysis of multi-component icosahedral shell packing reproduction dataset
definition: Parse explicit shell, mismatch, validation, and growth tables from the provided reproduction file
Report stable structures directly named in the dataset
Summarize optimal mismatch ranges between adjacent shells using provided ranges and point estimates
Summarize growth-path behavior using provided dynamic-growth statistics
assumptions: The provided reproduction data is authoritative for this benchmark task
Stable structures are represented by the validated multicomponent_clusters entries
Universal-framework conclusions should be phrased as data-supported within this compact reproduction dataset
invariants: Do not modify read-only source data
Keep all main quantitative claims traceable to outputs artifacts
Preserve shell-category labels MC, BG, and Ch1-Ch5 exactly as given
non_negotiable_steps: Generate at least one validation plot comparing theory and experiment
Generate at least one path/growth figure
deviations: Could not extract text from related_work PDFs using built-in ReadPDF or pdftotext; report notes this limitation and relies primarily on the provided reproduction dataset.
